utterances.speaker: grandmother

utterances.speaker: grandmother

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Thank you, dear. That means a lot to me. I'm always trying to be careful on the road.

utterances.speaker: grandson

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I understand, dear. Driving can be intimidating for some people, but with practice, it becomes easier.

utterances.speaker: grandson

utterances.speaker: grandson

utterances.speaker: grandmother

utterances.speaker: grandson

utterances.speaker: grandmother

utterances.speaker: grandmother

utterances.speaker: grandmother

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh my, that sounds like quite the adventure! I suppose I should give it a try sometime.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
